title: Robo-Cortex: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent via Dual-Grain Cognitive Memory and Autonomous Knowledge Induction
problem: Embodied agents fail to convert past navigation interactions into transferable decision strategies.
assumption_broken: Experience need not remain scene-specific trajectories but can become reusable natural-language heuristics.
operational_signature: Execute → reflect → abstract → consolidate → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Autonomous Knowledge Induction merges recurring success and failure patterns into reusable heuristic guidance.

improver_modified.how: Induced heuristics guide subsequent short-term reflective analysis as well as planning.

limitations_evident: Preliminary small-scale real-world validation
No systematic backbone comparison
Online rewriting can overwrite useful transferred guidance

title: Prompt Optimization for LLM Code Generation via Reinforcement Learning
problem: Static prompts and sparse correctness feedback limit functional code generation.
assumption_broken: Prompt transformation operators need not be scheduled by fixed heuristics.
operational_signature: Encode → choose transformation → generate → execute → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: A PPO policy schedules complementary prompt edits using shaped partial-test rewards.

improver_modified.how: PPO updates the policy that selects prompt transformations.

limitations_evident: Prompt-only state omits code and traceback feedback
Separate policies per dataset and backbone
Evaluation test use and inference claims are not fully reconciled

title: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries
problem: Unmanaged skill accumulation causes retrieval degradation and harmful guidance injection.
assumption_broken: Adding plausible skills is not necessarily beneficial without evidence-driven lifecycle management.
operational_signature: Log outcomes → attribute failures → synthesize → route → retire
load_bearing_mechanism: A meta-skill authoring prior combined with conservative retirement and a bounded library prevents library drift.

improver_modified.how: An ablated variant periodically regenerates the meta-skill that guides skill synthesis.

limitations_evident: Single model and 100 difficult code tasks
Governance settings are scale-dependent
Full system incurs 43% more calls than no-skill baseline

title: OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents
problem: Desktop benchmark construction lacks scalable trustworthy checks of hidden application state.
assumption_broken: Verification can be an iteratively repaired organizing layer rather than a fixed downstream judge.
operational_signature: Generate checks → execute probes → compare verdicts → repair checks → retest
load_bearing_mechanism: Verifier-side disagreements on fixed cached executions drive bounded repairs without changing task objectives or outcomes.
limitations_evident: Visual and geometric criteria may resist programmatic verification
Reference LLM judgments can be imperfect
Official tasks are constrained by inspectable software state

title: APEX: Autonomous Policy Exploration for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
problem: Cross-episode reflection collapses exploration onto familiar reward-producing routines.
assumption_broken: An agent's strategy space can be explicitly constructed and expanded rather than left implicit in memory.
operational_signature: Map prerequisites → select frontier → execute → propagate reward → discover alternatives
load_bearing_mechanism: Evidence-grounded fork discovery expands a milestone DAG while uncertainty-aware selection explores its reachable frontier.
limitations_evident: Cannot discover directions entirely outside observed experience
Milestone quality depends on LLM inference
Continuous progress tasks are not evaluated

title: Trace2Skill: Verifier-Guided Skill Evolution for Long-Context EDA Agents
problem: Sparse hidden-verifier failures leave long-context hardware agents without actionable recovery guidance.
assumption_broken: Test-time scaling can evolve the skill governing future rollouts rather than only generate more code candidates.
operational_signature: Roll out → diagnose traces → extract lessons → mutate guidance → select survivor
load_bearing_mechanism: Pass-dominant skill selection combines sanitized verifier progress with lesson-preserving semantic gates.
limitations_evident: Only eight hard adaptation tasks
Reported outcomes are optimization rollouts rather than held-out tests
Shared skills transfer unreliably across tasks

title: FlyRoute: Self-Evolving Agent Profiling via Data Flywheel for Adaptive Task Routing
problem: Static expert descriptions fail to capture empirically observed routing capabilities.
assumption_broken: Agent profiles can be continuously inferred from successful traffic instead of maintained manually at registration.
operational_signature: Route → probe → judge → store successes → distill profiles
load_bearing_mechanism: Quality-gated successes and coverage-aware exploration refine descriptions and retrieved routing exemplars.
limitations_evident: Proprietary logs and only four expert routes
Controlled capability shifts are not tested
Quality-gate calibration can affect profiles

title: Ratchet: How Reliable Must an LLM Judge Be to Retire a Skill?
problem: Noisy judge feedback can silently disable outcome-driven skill retirement.
assumption_broken: More trials cannot repair asymmetric judge bias that shifts the retirement statistic past its decision boundary.
operational_signature: Route artifact → grade outcome → log evidence → estimate contribution → evict
load_bearing_mechanism: Bounded library width and evidence-threshold retirement provide a performance floor only under directional judge-reliability conditions.
limitations_evident: Exogenous corruption excludes adaptive exploitation of judge blind spots
Audits cover only enumerable defect classes
Contribution estimates are associational rather than causal

title: Adapting the Interface, Not the Model: Runtime Harness Adaptation for Deterministic LLM Agents
problem: Frozen agents fail at deterministic model-environment interfaces despite adequate underlying reasoning.
assumption_broken: Adaptation need not reside in model parameters or input prompts alone.
operational_signature: Collect trajectories → localize failures → edit interface → validate → retain improvement
load_bearing_mechanism: Lifecycle-specific harness interventions repair contracts, skill guidance, action realization, and trajectory regulation.
limitations_evident: Only text- and API-based environments
Harnesses remain environment-specific
Deterministic interface structure is central to the method

title: EvoIR-Agent: Self-Evolving Image Restoration Agentic System via Experience-Driven Learning
problem: Naive static experience causes expensive trial and error in training-free image restoration agents.
assumption_broken: Tool and restoration-order preferences depend on fine-grained degradation patterns rather than degradation type alone.
operational_signature: Explore outcomes → compare quality → estimate priorities → cluster patterns → retrieve guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical experience stores statistically learned quality rankings at preference, degradation-type, and pattern levels.
limitations_evident: Atomic experience acquisition exhaustively evaluates candidates
Quality depends on chosen IQA preferences
Detailed evolution and inference splits are deferred to appendices

title: DeliCIR: Memory-Guided Test-Time Deliberation via Multi-Agent Collaboration for Composed Image Retrieval
problem: Composed retrieval suffers from single-view perception limits and logical drift during candidate comparison.
assumption_broken: A pretrained retriever can supply candidates while external experience-guided deliberation determines final precision.
operational_signature: Sample reasoning → compare outcomes → distill advantages → consolidate memory → deliberate
load_bearing_mechanism: Contrasting successful and failed reasoning distills reusable candidate-discrimination guidelines for tournament-style deliberation.
limitations_evident: Experience-extraction split details are omitted from condensed text
Excessive deliberation depth can reduce accuracy
Candidate-pool expansion has diminishing returns

title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems via Decentralized Memory
problem: Centralized memory homogenizes multi-agent strategies and adds coordination overhead.
assumption_broken: Persistent collaborative experience need not be pooled globally across agents.
operational_signature: Retrieve or explore → collaborate → judge stages → reweight routing → consolidate locally
load_bearing_mechanism: Agent-private exploitation and exploration pools preserve specialization while feedback adapts reuse probabilities.
limitations_evident: Judge reliability is not established in the provided text
Reachability assumes nonzero prior support everywhere
Regret guarantee requires strict concavity assumptions

title: MOSS: Self-Evolution through Source-Level Rewriting in Autonomous Agent Systems
problem: Production agent failures in routing, state, and dispatch are unreachable through text-only adaptation.
assumption_broken: The production agent harness itself can be safely rewritten rather than held immutable.
operational_signature: Curate failures → delegate edits → replay isolated trials → approve → swap or roll back
load_bearing_mechanism: Directed source edits are verified on replayed production failures before consent-gated container promotion.
limitations_evident: Reported improvement covers four replayed tasks in one cycle
No held-out generalization evidence in provided text
Production safety relies on isolation and rollback checks

title: PACE: Two-Timescale Self-Evolution for Small Language Model Agents
problem: Small-model prompt optimization saturates while premature structural edits cause regressions.
assumption_broken: Prompt and executable control-logic updates should not be treated as equally timed adaptation actions.
operational_signature: Refine prompts → detect saturation → propose bounded code edit → validate → resume refinement
load_bearing_mechanism: Prompt-saturation gating delays risky control-logic search until empirical validation can justify structural changes.
limitations_evident: Structural gains increase inference token cost substantially
Smallest backbone remains capacity-limited on HotpotQA
Validation subsets are reused from the training pool

title: From Raw Experience to Skill Consumption: A Systematic Study of Model-Generated Agent Skills
problem: Skill extraction quality is poorly predicted by plausibility or model strength and can cause negative transfer.
assumption_broken: A skill that reads better or comes from a stronger model need not have higher downstream utility.
operational_signature: Generate experience → extract patterns → consolidate skills → measure utility → derive authoring criteria
load_bearing_mechanism: Utility-validated contrasts between skill pairs yield a meta-skill prior that guides more effective extraction.

improver_modified.how: A meta-skill distilled from utility-grounded rubric analysis modifies the extractor's system prompt.

limitations_evident: Meta-skill rubric derives from evaluated skill pairs
Main study extracts a single domain-level skill
Skill utility varies strongly by consumer

title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
problem: Uncontrolled skill rewrites erase useful guidance and fail to reliably improve frozen agents.
assumption_broken: A skill document can be optimized with bounded training-style updates rather than loosely revised.
operational_signature: Collect scored rollouts → reflect in batches → rank bounded edits → validate → consolidate meta-guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: Textual edit budgets and strict disjoint-selection gating stabilize iterative skill optimization.

improver_modified.how: Optimizer-side meta-skills summarize accepted and rejected edit patterns to guide future reflection and ranking.

limitations_evident: Optimizes one skill for one target domain
Requires scored selection data
Needs a separate strong optimizer model

title: SkillEvolBench: Benchmarking the Evolution from Episodic Experience to Procedural Skills
problem: Local recovery with distilled skills is often mistaken for durable procedural generalization.
assumption_broken: More skill updates or larger skill resource bundles do not necessarily improve frozen deployment performance.
operational_signature: Acquire episodes → compact evidence → author skills → freeze library → test shifted deployment
load_bearing_mechanism: Role-conditioned task families and raw-trajectory controls separate procedural abstraction from episodic reuse.
limitations_evident: 180 constructed tasks in six environments
Libraries do not transfer between environments
Current abstraction frequently loses useful trajectory detail

title: CODESKILL: Learning Self-Evolving Skills for Coding Agents
problem: Fixed skill-extraction prompts and maintenance heuristics poorly optimize downstream coding utility.
assumption_broken: Skill extraction and bank maintenance can be learned as a policy rather than prescribed heuristically.
operational_signature: Extract or revise → maintain bank → execute with skills → attribute gains → train manager
load_bearing_mechanism: GRPO trains skill management with rubric quality and baseline-relative execution rewards gated by observed skill use.

improver_modified.how: SFT and GRPO update the model that extracts, evolves, and maintains the skill bank.

limitations_evident: Test-bank construction uses two preparatory passes over test tasks
Same-instance skills are excluded through provenance tracking
End-to-end acquisition and maintenance costs remain future work

title: Retrieval as Reasoning: Self-Evolving Agent-Native Retrieval via LLM-Wiki
problem: Flat retrieval indices hinder compositional reasoning and compiled knowledge accumulates recurring errors.
assumption_broken: External knowledge can be a maintained navigable reasoning substrate instead of a static chunk index.
operational_signature: Compile → validate → attribute errors → inject constraints → repair and revalidate
load_bearing_mechanism: A persistent Error Book converts compilation failures into reusable constraints and two-layer repairs.

improver_modified.how: Generated error constraints modify subsequent knowledge-compilation prompts.

limitations_evident: Uses dataset-provided context rather than full-Wikipedia retrieval
Larger tool-call budget than baselines
Compilation cost and large-scale index maintenance remain bottlenecks

title: Behind EvoMap: Characterizing a Self-Evolving Agent-to-Agent Collaboration Network
problem: Large-scale shared instruction networks can grow without trustworthy reuse, evolution, or validation.
assumption_broken: Publication rewards and self-reported quality are not reliable proxies for useful agent collaboration.
operational_signature: Retrieve instructions → generate or repair → validate locally → publish → rank for reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: The studied network ranks reusable assets through metadata-heavy GDI scores, which the audit finds manipulable.
limitations_evident: Observational study of one network over 47 days
Reuse and execution metadata are self-reported
98% of assets are never reused

title: When Search Becomes Memory: Accelerating Robot Design Discovery with Self-Evolving Skills
problem: Expensive morphology evaluations are discarded as implicit population knowledge instead of reusable design principles.
assumption_broken: Transfer across robot scales can preserve functional structural relations rather than resize elite designs.
operational_signature: Retrieve rules → edit elites → simulate → diagnose gains → add and merge skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Evidence-grounded archetypes and positive or negative relational rules guide future proposals while GA mutation preserves exploration.
limitations_evident: Only 2D EvoGym simulation with fixed PPO protocol
Some transferred rules need a geometric exemplar
No hardware or sim-to-real validation

title: SetupX: Can LLM Agents Learn from Past Failures in Functionality-Correct Code Repository Setup?
problem: Repository setup agents repeat dependency failures and cannot safely undo non-invertible repairs.
assumption_broken: Verified setup fixes can transfer across repositories when stored with diagnostic triggers and executable actions.
operational_signature: Distill fixes → retrieve → snapshot and trial → audit delayed effects → reweight experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Structured experience units combine verified repair guidance with telemetry-driven retrieval and snapshot-backed rollback.
limitations_evident: Single-run containerized Python setup evaluation
Independent adjudication still relies on an LLM
Long-term telemetry-driven evolution is not validated

title: CyberEvolver: Structured Self-Evolution for Cybersecurity Agents On the Fly
problem: Fixed security-agent scaffolds fail to adapt to heterogeneous targets and obscured execution feedback.
assumption_broken: Target-specific scaffold changes can exceed the capability ceiling of repeatedly sampling an unchanged agent.
operational_signature: Execute → compress evidence → diagnose layers → branch mutations → retain promising variants
load_bearing_mechanism: Layer-attributed trajectory diagnosis guides diverse scaffold mutations maintained through population beam search.
limitations_evident: Only controlled offensive security benchmarks
No cross-target transfer study
Most expert baselines use fewer attempts

title: Verilog-Evolve: Feedback-Driven and Skill-Evolving Verilog Generation
problem: Isolated generation and functional checking fail to accumulate reusable guidance or optimize downstream artifact quality.
assumption_broken: Passing functional tests is not sufficient to select useful implementations or trustworthy reusable skills.
operational_signature: Retrieve guidance → diversify candidates → execute evaluators → promote improvements → validate reusable lessons
load_bearing_mechanism: Executable multi-objective feedback gates versioned candidate promotion and replay-validated publication of cross-session skills.
limitations_evident: Held-out tests participate in promotion
Only three downstream GEMM tasks
Timing proxies do not establish physical-design quality

title: Towards Feedback-to-Plan Decisions for Self-Evolving LLM Agents in CUDA Kernel Generation
problem: End-to-end feedback ablations confound immediate planning effects with accumulated trajectory drift.
assumption_broken: Explicit planning and additional diagnostics are not intrinsically useful without aligned feedback and component interactions.
operational_signature: Freeze state → inject feedback subsets → generate plans → execute revisions → attribute interactions
load_bearing_mechanism: Frozen-generation feedback interventions isolate marginal and coalitional effects on subsequent planning outcomes.
limitations_evident: Conditional attribution at frozen generations only
Does not explain internal planner mechanisms
Cross-generation semantic credit assignment remains unresolved

title: SIA: Self Improving AI with Harness & Weight Updates
problem: Harness-only adaptation plateaus while fixed training pipelines cannot dynamically exploit scaffolded task feedback.
assumption_broken: The scaffold and model weights need not be optimized in separate fixed pipelines.
operational_signature: Execute → diagnose reward dynamics → choose adaptation lever → revise scaffold or train weights → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: A feedback agent selects between scaffold edits and task-conditioned reinforcement-learning weight updates when progress stalls.
limitations_evident: LawBench test scores supply training rewards
Only three task-specific demonstrations
No budget-matched weight-only control shown

title: MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation
problem: One-off skill creation neglects runtime context, accumulated experience, validation, and maintenance.
assumption_broken: Skills can be managed as evolving testable assets rather than static isolated generation outputs.
operational_signature: Execute → distill procedure → test and repair → register with experience → retrieve and maintain
load_bearing_mechanism: A runtime-integrated skill lifecycle couples package creation and repair with per-skill memory and executable validation.
limitations_evident: Source skills re-evaluated on the same SkillsBench tasks
Only 47 of 75 tasks yield usable MUSE skills
Transfer tested only into Hermes and token traces incomplete

title: A Relative-Computability Theory of Self-Improving Agents
problem: Recursive self-revision is often conflated with expansion of computational reach without explicit resource and completion semantics.
assumption_broken: Editing the improver or internalizing finite teacher experience does not alone imply a higher computability layer.
operational_signature: Declare resources → propose queries → accumulate independent constraints → certify coverage → remove teacher dependence
load_bearing_mechanism: A finite-dimensional feature-span specification supplies an exact completion certificate while uniform simulation bounds the reach of mutable improvers.

improver_modified.how: The formal acquisition protocol permits effective revisions to its bounded query proposer.

limitations_evident: Formal deterministic exact-decision setting
Requires known noiseless finite feature structure
No practical improvement-rate or cost theory

title: ESC-Skills: Discovering and Self-Evolving Skills for Emotional Support Conversations
problem: Static support strategies fail to capture intervention outcomes and profile-dependent failure patterns.
assumption_broken: Surface empathy and static skill induction do not guarantee constructive long-horizon emotional outcomes.
operational_signature: Extract transitions → induce procedures → simulate diverse profiles → diagnose failures → verify refinements
load_bearing_mechanism: Simulation-based generation–verification filters skill refinements using observed state-transition outcomes.
limitations_evident: Simulated seekers without live-user or counselor evaluation
English emotional support only
Fixed deployment bank without safe online adaptation

title: Does Capability Transfer to Subjective Behavior -- and Would Our Instruments Tell Us? A Self-Evolving, Trust-by-Construction Evaluation Paradigm
problem: Subjective behavioral evaluations lack stable human anchors and aggregate scores can hide dimension-specific regressions.
assumption_broken: A fixed human-authored rubric or human correlation alone need not establish a trustworthy subjective instrument.
operational_signature: Seed dimensions → prune redundancy → propose discrete mutations → gate composite fitness → freeze and replicate
load_bearing_mechanism: Strictly improving multiplicative fitness balances discrimination, reliability, transfer, and orthogonality while rejecting gameable rubric mutations.
limitations_evident: Human same-rubric construct validation remains limited
Two trust certificates share the same ensemble
Evolution adds or removes dimensions without refining definitions
